commits.message: Paste: the program hears it first and may claim it, a flush ends an open paste as one, a tab is a space, only a final line break is dropped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)
Paste: Escape ahead of a paste stays Escape, no control reaches a field, the field follows a paste, the end marker is sought once, WidgetApp hears pastes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)
App turns on bracketed paste, and a paste reaches a program as one event, never as the keys it holds (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)

Console sets the window title, the clipboard and a desktop notification (#558)

* Console sets the window title, the clipboard and a desktop notification, through one identification of the terminal and of tmux (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)

* Requests: one identity per console, the title left to multiplexers, kitty ids per notification, OSC 9 kept off ConEmu's shape, screen passthrough, one OSC text rule (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)

* Requests: OSC 9 behind any intermediary, BEL inside screen's DCS, kitty ids unique past the console, ids taken only when written (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)

* Requests: multiplexers count beside their own TERM, screen gets nothing it would cut, random kitty ids, lazy encoding, one attended rule (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)

* Screen's buffer is measured in bytes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)

* isAttended sits below the doc comment it does not own (rich-control-codes-xh4n.4w6)
